content: Teemb ndeem, ŋ hotta teere ŋ yaahi ñaahmiŋ Yi ɓoof ŋ ɓoofoha-buuri, wa raakeen fiis ŋ ɗooƴi na ɗafki, wa ñaakɗuusa na ndaɗ yasna-kanak ne wa rangu, ndaɗ nu nik raakka mandargaani teeɓoh ne teerndi ranguuɗ ŋ tiikiŋ Kooh.
Ŋ hotta malaaka raakiɗ hatil leehkeeɗa an : « A ɓa yeyyoo nihis ndaɗ ci, a rangis teerndi ? »
Waaye yi yeyyoo rangis teerndi a marak ɗooƴi, raakɗi ; wa ŋ Asamaan haa, wa ŋ kehƴi haa, wa ŋ ooɓ kehƴi haa.
Ŋ fuɗeeɗa fuɗ miskiɗ ŋ ini ali ɓo' yeyyooɗi rangis teerndi, ɓo' yeyyooɗi marak ŋ ɗooƴi.
Yakak yino ŋ yakak ca woosa so ne : « Kina fuɗ. Marka, gayndeeniŋ cuuɓiŋ Yudaa, yi setiŋ Dawuuda saahiɗ ɓi sang ɗe ; a yeyyoo'iɗ nihis ndaɗ ci yasna-kanak ci, a rangis teerndi. »

Weɗ ŋ hotoh kuy mbaal ƴin. A tufkee ŋ leernaŋ ɓoofoha-buura ; pesiɗ ca nikiis ca na yakak ca willa ɗe. A mandee na ini hoosu ; a raakee wiic yasna-kanak na has yasna-kanak, ceɗ Fuuɗis ciŋ Kooh yasna-kanak ci woosohu ŋ kehƴi jen.
Kuyaŋ Mbaala ƴina kaɗta, a ɓayya teernda nikee ŋ yaah-ñaahmiŋ Yi ɓoof ŋ ɓoofoha-buuri.

Wa a ɓaya, pesiɗ ca nikiis ca na yakak ca ndaŋkiyaah-kanak ca na nikiis ca (24) ƴekiɗta Kuyaŋ Mbaala ƴina. Raak yaa nu nga ambiɗ koora na kaas urus riifiɗ na cuuraay, cuuraay ceem ceɗ kiim ciŋ ɓo'-Kooh ci.

content.text: Laam fu hoosuuɗ ne fu seeƴkohu
fu tosiɗ wuu Kooh ɓo' laayiɗ,
ngaŋ heet ci jen na peɗeem ci jen,
cuuɓ ci jen na kur ci jen.
fu tummba ɓa seeƴkiɗoh wuu Koohiŋ ɓoo
te ɓa hey nike buur ŋ kehƴi jen. »

content: Ŋ markissa, ŋ kerahha hooso malaaka laayoh na laayoh, ɓa nikee ɓi milyongi milyong malaaka, ɓa willa ɓoofoha-buura, na pesiɗ ca na yakak ca.
Ŋ nammba kerah in ci Kooh fer ŋ Eel ci, na kehƴi na ooɓ kehƴi na ɗooƴ cookmi, in ci nik ŋ Adina jen ƴeekeeɗa an :
Pesiɗ ca nikiis ca woyeeɗa ne « Amiin ! » Te yakak ca raɗukka ñar, ñaamkeeɗa.
